neighbours.label: the verb ' make'/' makes' (causative make: X makes Y do/be something)
fire: Too much coffee in the evening can make you restless all night.
Engineers added a coating that makes the glass harder to scratch.
A few small changes will make your kitchen feel much bigger.
Loud music in the office tends to make people less productive.
The new update makes the app load twice as fast on old phones.
Bright colors on the walls can make a small room look cheerful.
Researchers found a gene that makes some plants resist drought.
Adding salt early will make the dough tougher than you want.
quiet: Too much coffee in the evening can keep you restless all night.
Engineers added a coating so the glass resists scratches better.
A few small changes will help your kitchen feel much bigger.
Loud music in the office tends to leave people less productive.
The new update lets the app load twice as fast on old phones.
Bright colors on the walls can turn a small room cheerful.
Researchers found a gene that helps some plants resist drought.
Adding salt early will toughen the dough more than you want.
